title: RSVP collaborative BCI dataset from Zheng et al 2020
description: This dataset comprises synchronized EEG recordings from 14 healthy subjects performing a collaborative rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) task in pairs. The study implements a p300-based brain-computer interface for target image detection, with subjects discriminating between human and non-human images across two sessions. The dataset includes 62-channel EEG data sampled at 1000 Hz with standardized preprocessing and is designed to support BCI research and benchmarking studies. This is a MOABB-processed derivative of the original Zheng et al. 2020 study data.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Neuroscan Synamps2 system at 1000 Hz sampling rate from 62 electrodes in a standard 10-20 montage with vertex reference. Subjects performed RSVP target detection tasks in synchronized pairs across 2 sessions with 3 runs each. Visual stimuli were presented with 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony, and trials were segmented from 0-1 s post-stimulus onset. Data were processed and standardized using the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB) framework version 1.5.0.
